summary: Craftroot Retail Limited held its 34th AGM on September 25, 2026, via video conferencing. Members adopted FY26 financial statements and reappointed key directors.

headline: Patel Engineering closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Patel Engineering Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the declaration of un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Galaxy Bearings delays land sale deed execution
summary: Galaxy Bearings Ltd reports non-execution of Tranche 2 industrial land sale to Treefac Works LLP for ₹150 lakh due to procedural delays at counterparty.

headline: Systematic Industries FY26 results: PAT up 16.4%
summary: Systematic Industries reported a 16.4% YoY rise in PAT to ₹210 Mn for FY26. Revenue grew 23.9% to ₹5,563 Mn, driven by power and telecom demand.

headline: Galaxy Bearings closes trading window from Oct 1
summary: Galaxy Bearings Ltd will close its trading window starting October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring Q2FY27 results. This action complies with SEBI insider trading regulations.

headline: Automotive Axles management raises FY27 outlook to 8%
summary: Automotive Axles management has revised its FY27 growth outlook upward from 7.5% to 8%, according to an interview with company management.

headline: Rishi Laser holds 34th AGM via VC
summary: Rishi Laser Limited conducted its 34th Annual General Meeting on September 25, 2026, via video conferencing. Key resolutions included adopting FY26 financials and reappointing a director.

headline: Safecure Services adopts FY26 financials, re-appoints MD
summary: Safecure Services Limited held its 14th AGM on September 25, 2026, adopting FY26 financials and re-appointing Shailendra Mahesh Pandey as Managing Director.

headline: Mehta Securities holds 32nd AGM
summary: Mehta Securities Ltd held its 32nd AGM on September 25, 2026, approving financial statements and director re-appointment.

headline: Infra Industries closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Infra Industries Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the approval of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026.

headline: Omax Autos closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Omax Autos Limited has closed its trading window for designated persons from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after the declaration of Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: STC India gets 2.8-month AGM extension
summary: State Trading Corporation of India Ltd received a 2 months and 25 days extension from the RoC to hold its FY26 AGM due to pending CAG comments.

headline: Sammaan Capital allots ₹750 crore NCDs
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited allotted ₹750 crore in Non-Convertible Debentures across three series on September 25, 2026. The issue features coupons ranging from 9.05% to 9.75% with tenors up to 3 years.

headline: Sangal Papers gets ₹14.67 lakh tax demand
summary: Sangal Papers received a rectification order from the Income Tax Department for A.Y. 2025-26, resulting in a demand of ₹14.67 lakh. The company disclosed the impact as maximum ₹14.67 lakh.

headline: Rudra Global Infra concludes 16th AGM
summary: Rudra Global Infra Products Limited held its 16th Annual General Meeting on September 25, 2026, in Bhavnagar. The meeting reviewed FY26 performance and business opportunities.

headline: Ranjeet Mechatronics adopts FY26 financials at AGM
summary: Ranjeet Mechatronics adopted audited FY26 financials and re-appointed director Devarshibhai Swadia at its 33rd AGM held on September 25, 2026.

headline: Kalpataru subsidiary gets ₹14 Cr GST notice
summary: Ananta Landmarks, a wholly owned subsidiary of Kalpataru Ltd, received a show cause notice for ₹14 crore from the GST Department for FY23. The company states the notice lacks merit and will contest it.
